Bloody Roar II - Turbo Mode
===========================

Runs the game at an arcade-style turbo cadence:

  - 75 Hz  (x1.25)   - 120 Hz (x2)   - Uncapped (as fast as the host allows)

The guest VBlank is re-paced, so every per-frame mechanic (hitstun, recovery,
projectiles) advances faster together — the fight plays quicker while staying
internally consistent, like the classic arcade Turbo editions.

Enable it from the launcher's Mods tab and pick a rate (default off).
Netplay sessions disable mods, so online matches always stay at the vanilla
60 Hz cadence.
